situation: I'm Alina. Had a final-round interview yesterday for a product designer role at Larkspur Health with the head of design, Marcus. He talked a lot about their accessibility audit. I fumbled a question about design systems: I forgot to say that at my last job, at Norvell, I set up the shared component library, which cut our handoff time roughly in half.
reply:
Hi Marcus,
Thank you for the conversation yesterday. What you said about the accessibility audit stuck with me; it's the kind of work I'd want to be part of. One thing I'd add to my answer on design systems: at Norvell I set up the shared component library, which cut our handoff time roughly in half, which I didn't get to mention in the moment. I'm very interested in the role and happy to send anything else that helps.
Best,
Alina
note: Within 24 hours, one specific thing he said, one clarification, one line of interest. Not a second cover letter.

situation: 我是陈静。今天下午和合作方开了项目启动会，定了几件事：先做华东区试点，对方的孙经理10月9日前提供门店数据，我10月10日前出排期。想发个会后纪要。
reply:
各位好，感谢今天的时间，简单整理一下会议结论，确保大家理解一致：
- 先做华东区试点。
- 孙经理：10月9日前提供门店数据。
- 我：10月10日前发出完整排期。
如有记错的地方请直接指出。
陈静
note: 会后纪要当天发，每一项都有负责人和日期，写下你希望成为事实的版本。

situation: Interviewed for an account manager job at Crestline Logistics 5 weeks ago; the recruiter, Hannah, said I'd hear back within two weeks. I sent one check-in two weeks ago and still nothing.
reply: Hi Hannah, I'll take the quiet as the timing not working out on your side. Thanks again for your time, and I'd be glad to hear from you if a similar role opens up at Crestline.
note: One check-in was already sent, so this is the short closing note. It leaves a good last impression without chasing.

situation: Had a phone screen today with Grace, the director of Harbor Food Bank, for the program manager role. She said long wait times at the pantries are the biggest complaint from clients, and invited me to a final round on Wednesday 7 October at 10am at their Pier Street warehouse with her and the operations lead, Ben. She asked me to bring a one-page plan for cutting wait times.
reply:
Hi Grace,
Thank you for the call today, and for being so open that wait times are the biggest complaint from clients; it's a problem I'd really like to work on. To confirm: the final round is on Wednesday 7 October at 10am at the Pier Street warehouse, with you and Ben, and I'll bring a one-page plan for cutting wait times. I'm looking forward to it.
Best regards
note: When the call ends with a next step, the follow-up confirms the logistics in one line so a wrong time or place gets caught now, not on the day.

situation: 今天约了行业前辈刘老师喝咖啡，聊了一个小时。她建议我找一个产品从头到尾拆一遍，推荐了一本用户体验的入门书，还说可以把我介绍给她的前同事陈磊。我打算拿自己天天用的记账App来拆。想发微信谢谢她。
reply: 刘老师，谢谢您今天抽出一个小时跟我聊。您说的“找一个产品从头到尾拆一遍”对我特别有用，我这周就按您推荐的那本入门书把我天天用的记账App拆一遍，周日前整理好发您看看。您提到可以介绍陈磊，我先写一段简短的自我介绍发您，您觉得合适再转给他就好。
note: 约前辈喝咖啡后的跟进：引用她自己的建议，说明你已经在做并给出日期，再让她转介绍时毫不费力。

situation: At the HospitalityX trade show yesterday I talked for 10 minutes at our stand with Priyanka, head of procurement at Aster Hotels. We sell commercial laundry equipment; our HX-40 washers use about 30% less power per load than the 2018 models most hotels are replacing. I have a one-page spec sheet with the figures. She said they're replacing machines at 3 properties next spring and asked about energy use. I have her card.
reply:
Subject: Energy figures for the Aster laundry refit

Hi Priyanka, thanks for stopping by our stand at HospitalityX yesterday. You asked about energy use: our HX-40 washers use about 30 percent less power per load than the 2018 models most hotels are replacing, and the one-page spec with the figures is attached. If it would help your spring planning, I can send an estimate for all three properties by Friday 16 October. Would that be useful?
note: Answer the one question she actually asked, then offer a small next step, not a demo call.

situation: After Monday's kickoff with our design agency I sent a recap saying they'd deliver wireframes by Friday Oct 9. Their lead, Tom, replied-all: 'That's not what we agreed, we said the 9th for the homepage only and the other pages the week after.' Thinking back, he's probably right.
reply: Thanks for the correction, Tom. I've updated the notes: homepage wireframes by Friday Oct 9, the remaining pages by Friday Oct 16. Everything else in the recap stands. Shout if anything else is off.
note: When a recap gets pushback, correct it, thank them and move on. Arguing about who said what in a reply-all costs more than the date.

situation: I'm Maya. Had my 1:1 with my manager Dana today about getting promoted to senior engineer. She said if I lead the billing migration (cutover planned for 15 January) and mentor our new hire Theo, she'll put me forward in the March cycle. I want it in writing without sounding like I'm lawyering her.
reply:
Hi Dana,
Thanks for the time today, it was really useful to hear exactly what the path to senior looks like. Quick recap so we're aligned:
- I'll lead the billing migration, with cutover planned for 15 January.
- I'll mentor Theo.
- If both land, you'll put me forward in the March promotion cycle.
Shout if I've got anything wrong. I'll send you a first progress update by Tuesday 3 November.
Maya
note: A career conversation is a meeting too: the recap with owners and dates is what turns 'if you do this' into something both of you remember the same way.

situation: I'm an internal candidate for team lead on our support team of six. Interviewed yesterday with the director, Renata. She asked how I'd lead people who were my peers until last week, and I think my answer was too vague; what I meant was one-to-ones with everyone in my first two weeks, agreeing how we handle disagreements, and still taking a share of the escalation queue. Want to send her a thank-you on Slack.
reply: Hi Renata, thanks for the interview yesterday. Your question about leading people who've been my peers is the one I've kept thinking about, so here's the clearer answer: I'd hold a one-to-one with everyone on the team in my first two weeks, agree how we'll handle disagreements, and keep taking a share of the escalation queue so I stay close to the work. I'd really like this role, and I'm happy to talk it through further before you decide.
note: Internal follow-up: keep it short and in the channel you normally use, and spend it fixing the one weak answer rather than repeating the pitch.

situation: I'm Rachel Moore. Met today with my son Oliver's Year 5 teacher, Mrs Adeyemi, and the SENCO, Mr Hart, about his reading. We agreed he gets three extra reading sessions a week with the TA from Monday Oct 5, I read with him 15 minutes each evening, and we review on Monday Nov 16. I want a recap so it doesn't get lost.
reply:
Dear Mrs Adeyemi and Mr Hart,
Thank you for your time today. A quick recap so we're all on the same page:
- School: three extra reading sessions a week with the TA, starting Monday 5 October.
- Home: 15 minutes of reading with me each evening.
- All of us: review meeting on Monday 16 November.
Please let me know if I've got anything wrong.
Best wishes,
Rachel Moore
note: A recap works outside the office too: owners and dates on every point, so the plan survives a busy term.

situation: 我叫陈宇。9月22日终面了一家新能源车企的供应链岗位，HR刘女士说上周五前给结果，到今天还没消息，我还没催过。手上另一家的offer要10月9日前答复，但我更想去这家。国庆马上放假了。
reply:
刘女士您好，希望您这周一切顺利。上次您提到上周五前会有结果，想确认一下是否还需要我补充什么材料。另外坦白说明一下：我手上有另一家公司的offer，需要在10月9日前答复，但我更希望加入贵司的供应链团队。如果方便，能否在那之前告诉我大概的进展？谢谢您！
陈宇
note: 时间线过了只问一次，赶在国庆前发；另一家offer是真的才提，说清日期和你的偏好，不施压。

situation: I'm Arun. Pitched my B2B invoicing startup yesterday to Sofia Marin, a partner at Northbeam Ventures. She pushed hard on our churn and asked to see monthly cohort retention; we have cohorts since January 2025, and the March dip was two customers lost when their payroll platform shut down. Her partner meeting is Monday Oct 12.
reply: Hi Sofia, thanks for yesterday, and for pushing on churn; it's the right question to ask us. Attached is monthly cohort retention for every cohort since January 2025, with one line on the March dip: we lost two customers when their payroll platform shut down. If anything else would help before your partner meeting on Monday 12 October, tell me and I'll turn it around within a day. We'd very much like to work with Northbeam. Best, Arun
note: After a pitch, send exactly what they asked for, meet the hardest question head on, and anchor to their next date.

situation: Je suis Claire Martin. Hier, entretien pour un poste de chargée de communication à la mairie de Saint-Aubin-des-Prés, devant la directrice de la communication, Mme Garnier, un élu, M. Delorme, et une RH, Mme Haddad. Mme Garnier a beaucoup parlé de la refonte du journal municipal. Sur les réseaux sociaux, j'ai oublié de dire qu'à la communauté de communes du Val de l'Aubrive j'avais rédigé la charte de modération. Je voudrais remercier sans en faire trop.
reply:
Madame Garnier,
Je vous remercie, ainsi que M. Delorme et Mme Haddad, pour l'entretien d'hier. Ce que vous avez dit de la refonte du journal municipal m'a particulièrement marquée. J'ajoute un point à ma réponse sur les réseaux sociaux : à la communauté de communes du Val de l'Aubrive, j'ai aussi rédigé la charte de modération, ce que je n'ai pas eu le temps de mentionner. Ce poste m'intéresse vivement et je reste à votre disposition pour tout complément.
Je vous prie d'agréer, Madame, l'expression de mes salutations distinguées.
Claire Martin
note: Devant un jury, un seul message à la personne qui pilote le recrutement, en nommant les autres membres ; dans le public, le registre formel est attendu.

situation: 今天和房东王阿姨当面谈了续租：她同意11月1日起房租从4500涨到4700，签两年，10月底前她找人把坏了的热水器换掉。都是口头说的，我想发个微信确认一下。
reply:
王阿姨，谢谢您今天抽时间跟我当面聊，续租谈得这么顺我挺高兴的。我把今天说好的整理一下，免得以后记岔：
- 新合同11月1日起，签两年，月租4700元。
- 热水器10月31日前由您安排人换新，换的那天我在家配合。
- 合同我来打印两份，10月11日周日前找您签。
哪里记得不对您直接跟我说。
note: 口头谈好的事当天落到文字上，每一项写明谁做、哪天；她回一个“对”，这条消息就是双方一致的记录。

situation: 今天跟合作方开会，对方李总和我在交付时间上争得有点僵，我当时语气也冲了。最后定了分两期交付：第一期11月20日，第二期12月18日，他们10月16日前给齐素材，我们10月9日前发两期的详细排期。想发个会后纪要，顺便把气氛缓和一下。
reply:
李总好，今天会上我有几句说得急了，您别介意，也谢谢您最后一起想出分两期的办法。纪要如下，您看有没有出入：
- 第一期11月20日交付，第二期12月18日交付。
- 贵方10月16日前提供全部素材。
- 我方10月9日前发两期的详细排期。
哪里记得不对，您直接改就行。
note: 会上起了摩擦，纪要开头用一句话认下自己的语气，不重提争论本身，然后照常写清每件事谁负责、哪天完成。

situation: I'm Maria. Had a video interview yesterday for a data analyst role at Brightwell Insurance with the hiring manager, Olu. He talked about moving the claims team from monthly spreadsheets to a live dashboard. My wifi dropped for about ten minutes, so we rushed my SQL case study answer at the end; he was gracious about it, and I've since written my approach up properly on half a page.
reply:
Hi Olu,
Thank you for the conversation yesterday, and for being so gracious when my connection dropped. Your plan to move the claims team from monthly spreadsheets to a live dashboard stuck with me; it's exactly the kind of work I'd want to do. Since we rushed the SQL case study at the end, I've written up my approach in half a page, attached, in case it helps to see it in full. I'm very interested in the role and happy to answer anything else.
Best,
Maria
note: Thank him once for the grace, don't apologise again, and use the one addition to finish what the dropout cut short.

situation: Today's meeting with facilities and HR about the office move ended without deciding whether we move on Dec 12 or Jan 9. We agreed it depends on whether the new lease can start Dec 1, which Greta in facilities will confirm with the landlord by Monday Oct 5, and that we'll decide at Tuesday's meeting on Oct 6. I said I'd send the updated seating plan by Friday Oct 2.
reply:
Hi all, thanks for today. Quick recap so this doesn't drift:
- Still open: whether we move on Dec 12 or Jan 9. It depends on whether the new lease can start Dec 1.
- Greta: confirm the lease start date with the landlord by Monday Oct 5.
- Me: updated seating plan by Friday Oct 2.
- We decide the move date at Tuesday's meeting, Oct 6.
Shout if I've got anything wrong.
note: When a meeting ends undecided, the recap names the open question, who unblocks it, and when it gets decided.

situation: I'm Tom. In yesterday's renewal meeting with our client Hollis Dental, their ops manager Grace Liu asked for one invoice covering all four clinics, and I told her the new plan would cut their $3,000 monthly fee by 15%. I checked this morning and it's actually 11%, so $2,670 a month, not $2,550. I've since built the single invoice into the proposal and corrected the one-page summary. She's taking the numbers to her CFO on Monday Oct 5.
reply:
Hi Grace,
Thanks again for yesterday. Your ask for one invoice covering all four clinics is now built into the proposal. One correction before it goes to your CFO: the new plan cuts your monthly fee by 11%, not the 15% I said, which brings it from $3,000 to $2,670 a month rather than $2,550. The corrected one-page summary is attached so you have the right figure for Monday 5 October. Sorry for the mix-up, and shout if anything else would help.
Best,
Tom
note: When you got a number wrong in the meeting, the correction is the one thing the follow-up adds; send it before they repeat it upward.

situation: I viewed a one-bed flat on Elm Row yesterday with the letting agent, Sarah. At least five other people were there. I told her I can move in from November 1 and have my references and ID ready, and she mentioned the landlord wants a long-term tenant and is fine with my cat as long as I pay the pet deposit.
reply: Hi Sarah, thanks for showing me the Elm Row flat yesterday. I'd love to go ahead: I can move in from November 1, I'm looking to stay long term, and I'm happy to pay the pet deposit for my cat. I can send my references and ID today if that would help the landlord decide. Please let me know what you need next.
note: In a busy market the follow-up that wins is the one that makes saying yes easiest: restate the fit, offer the paperwork now.

situation: The recruiter at Fenwick Labs, Dana Ruiz, called me this afternoon with a verbal offer for the UX researcher role: $92,000 salary, starting Monday Nov 2, 25 days' leave, and working from home on Fridays. She asked me to reply by Monday Oct 5. I want to accept, but only once it's in writing.
reply:
Hi Dana,
Thank you for the call this afternoon, I'm really pleased. To make sure I have it right: the UX researcher role at $92,000, starting Monday 2 November, with 25 days' leave and working from home on Fridays. I'm keen to accept; could you send the written offer so I can review and sign it before Monday 5 October? Please correct me if I've got any detail wrong.
Thanks again
note: A verbal offer is a meeting too: recap the terms and ask for the written version before giving a firm yes.

situation: Dave, a roofer from Keel Roofing, came round yesterday to look at our leaking roof and showed us photos from the loft of where the water gets in. He said he'd replace about 20 broken tiles and reseal the chimney flashing for roughly £1,800, could start the week of 19 October, and would send a written quote. I want it confirmed in writing before we agree.
reply: Hi Dave, thanks for coming round yesterday, and for the loft photos; seeing exactly where the water gets in made it much easier to understand. So we're working from the same picture: replace about 20 broken tiles and reseal the chimney flashing, roughly £1,800, starting the week of 19 October. Could you send the written quote with that scope and price by Friday 9 October, so we can confirm the start date? Let me know if I've got anything wrong. Thanks!
note: As the customer, the recap protects you: restate scope, price and start, and get the written quote before saying yes.

situation: 佐々木美咲です。昨日、ミドリ建築設計の二次面接を受けました。面接官は設計部の山本部長で、来年始まる木造保育園のプロジェクトの話が特に印象に残りました。前職で木造の集合住宅を2件担当した経験を話しそびれたので、お礼メールで一言添えたいです。結果は来週中に連絡すると言われています。
reply:
ミドリ建築設計 設計部 山本部長

昨日はお忙しい中、面接のお時間をいただきありがとうございました。来年始まる木造保育園のプロジェクトのお話が特に印象に残り、ぜひ関わりたいという思いが強くなりました。面接でお伝えしそびれましたが、前職では木造の集合住宅を2件担当しており、その経験を活かせると考えております。来週中にご連絡いただけるとのこと、お待ちしております。引き続きどうぞよろしくお願いいたします。

佐々木美咲
note: 日本語の礼状は定型の丁寧さを守りつつ、面接で出た具体的な話題を一つ入れると埋もれない。

situation: 我叫周敏，想考王教授的硕士。昨天和她视频聊了20分钟，她说组里在用遥感做城市热岛研究，问我会不会Python，我只说了“会一点”，其实我本科毕业设计就是用Python处理了三年的卫星遥感影像。她说10月20日前决定今年收不收外校学生。
reply: 王老师您好，我是周敏，谢谢您昨天抽时间跟我视频。您讲组里用遥感做城市热岛研究，我听完更想加入了。补充一点昨天没说清楚的：我的本科毕业设计就是用Python处理了三年的卫星遥感影像，如果需要，我可以把代码和论文发给您看。您10月20日前做决定，这期间需要我补充什么材料，随时告诉我。
note: 导师面谈后的感谢信只补一件事：把面试时说轻了的能力讲具体。

situation: 我叫林悦。今天下午和主管王经理做了季度绩效面谈，她指出两个问题：周报经常晚交，客户邮件回复太慢。我们说好：周报每周五下午5点前交，客户邮件24小时内回复，11月13日再面谈一次看进展。想发个纪要，表明我认真对待，又不显得在辩解。
reply:
王经理，谢谢您今天花时间跟我做绩效面谈，两个问题您说得很直接，对我很有帮助。我把说好的整理一下：
- 周报：每周五下午5点前交。
- 客户邮件：收到后24小时内回复。
- 11月13日（周五）再面谈一次，看进展。
哪里记得不对，您直接告诉我。
林悦
note: 被指出问题后的纪要不解释原因，只把改进的承诺和复盘时间写清楚。

situation: I'm Ravi, engineering manager at a small startup, and I interviewed a candidate, Lucy, for a backend role today; she asked sharp questions about our on-call rota. The next step is a paid take-home task, $300 for about four hours of work, which I'll send by Monday 5 October with a week to complete it, then a final call with our CTO, Mei. I want to email her so she isn't left guessing.
reply:
Hi Lucy,
Thanks for the conversation today, and for your questions about our on-call rota; they're exactly the ones we'd want an engineer here to ask. Next step: I'll send you a paid take-home task by Monday 5 October. It should take about four hours, pays $300, and you'll have a week from receiving it to complete it. After that comes a final call with our CTO, Mei. Let me know if any of that doesn't work for you.
Best,
Ravi
note: From the interviewer's side the shape is the same: one specific thing she said, then every next step with a date.

situation: I chair our school's parents' association and we met tonight about the winter fair on Saturday 28 November. We agreed: Joanne books the hall by Friday 9 October, Kofi asks local shops for raffle prizes by Friday 30 October, and I set up the volunteer sign-up sheet by Monday 12 October. Two people who couldn't come are in the WhatsApp group and I want everyone on the same page.
reply:
Hi all, thanks to everyone who came tonight. Quick recap for the winter fair on Saturday 28 November, including for those who couldn't make it:
- Joanne: book the hall by Friday 9 October.
- Kofi: ask local shops for raffle prizes by Friday 30 October.
- Me: volunteer sign-up sheet in this group by Monday 12 October.
Shout if I've got anything wrong.
note: In a volunteer group chat, the recap is also the briefing for anyone who missed the meeting; names and dates keep it from drifting.

situation: Sou a Juliana, da associação de pais da Escola Municipal Ipê Amarelo. Hoje tive uma reunião com a vereadora Cláudia Ramos sobre a falta de faixa de pedestres na frente da escola, onde as crianças atravessam na saída das 17h. Ela disse que envia um ofício à secretaria de trânsito pedindo um estudo até sexta, 9 de outubro, e eu fiquei de mandar as fotos e o abaixo-assinado com 214 assinaturas até segunda, 5 de outubro.
reply:
Olá, vereadora Cláudia, obrigada pela reunião de hoje e por ouvir com atenção a situação da saída das 17h na Escola Municipal Ipê Amarelo. Resumo do que combinamos, para ficarmos alinhadas:
- Eu: envio as fotos e o abaixo-assinado com 214 assinaturas até segunda, 5 de outubro.
- Seu gabinete: ofício à secretaria de trânsito pedindo o estudo da faixa de pedestres até sexta, 9 de outubro.
Se anotei algo errado, por favor me corrija.
Juliana, associação de pais da Escola Municipal Ipê Amarelo
note: Com um representante eleito, o resumo por escrito transforma a promessa da reunião em algo que a associação pode acompanhar com data.

situation: 我叫刘畅，研二。今天下午和导师赵老师讨论开题，定下来几件事：题目改成聚焦长三角城市的社区养老服务；我10月16日前交文献综述初稿；赵老师帮我联系民政局，要2020到2025年的数据；开题答辩定在11月6日。想发微信给赵老师确认一下。
reply: 赵老师好，谢谢您今天下午帮我把开题思路理清楚。我把定下来的几件事整理一下：1. 题目调整为聚焦长三角城市的社区养老服务；2. 我10月16日前交文献综述初稿；3. 您帮忙联系民政局，要2020到2025年的数据；4. 开题答辩定在11月6日。如果有记错的地方，麻烦您指正。
note: 给导师的会后纪要：一句具体的感谢，每件事写清谁做、什么时候，最后请对方纠正，而不是再提新问题。

situation: I manage Joel, who came back today after six weeks off for knee surgery. In our return-to-work meeting we agreed: from Monday 5 October he works Mondays, Wednesdays and Fridays for four weeks, until Friday 30 October; no site visits until his physio clears him; and we check in every Friday at 2pm, starting Friday 9 October. Anita in HR will update his hours in the system by Monday 5 October.
reply:
Hi Joel, welcome back. Quick recap of what we agreed today, so it's all in one place:
- From Monday 5 October, you work Mondays, Wednesdays and Fridays for four weeks, until Friday 30 October.
- No site visits until your physio clears you.
- We check in every Friday at 2pm, starting Friday 9 October.
- Anita in HR updates your hours in the system by Monday 5 October.
If anything changes with your recovery, tell me and we'll look at the plan together. Shout if I've got anything wrong.
note: A return-to-work recap: owners and dates, and no medical detail beyond what he chose to share; for adjustments beyond this plan, bring in HR or occupational health rather than deciding alone.

situation: 我妈下周二（10月6日）做膝关节手术。今晚我们兄妹三个视频开了个会，定了：哥哥10月6日到10日请假在医院陪护；妹妹负责周末给妈做饭送饭；我10月8日前跟主治医生问清楚出院后的康复安排；费用三家平摊。还没定的是出院后妈住谁家，说好10月10日再开一次会。想在我们三个人的微信群里发个纪要。
reply:
哥、妹，今晚辛苦了，我把定下来的事理一下：
- 哥哥：10月6日到10日请假，在医院陪护。
- 妹妹：周末给妈做饭、送饭。
- 我：10月8日前跟主治医生问清楚出院后的康复安排，问完发群里。
- 费用：三家平摊。
还没定的：出院后妈住谁家，10月10日再开一次会定。有记错的直接在群里改。
note: 家里的会也要纪要：每件事写清谁、哪天，没定的事写明哪天再定，免得之后各说各的。

situation: I'm Ben, shift supervisor at our warehouse. This morning we met about Tuesday's near-miss, when a forklift reversed into aisle 3 while a picker was walking it. We agreed: Marta, our health and safety lead, logs it in the incident reporting system by Monday 5 October; aisle 3 is one-way from Monday; all drivers do refresher training by Friday 16 October; and I repaint the floor markings by Wednesday 7 October.
reply:
Hi all, thanks for this morning. Recap of what we agreed after Tuesday's near-miss in aisle 3:
- Marta: log it in the incident reporting system by Monday 5 October.
- Everyone: aisle 3 is one-way from Monday 5 October.
- All drivers: refresher training by Friday 16 October.
- Me: repaint the floor markings by Wednesday 7 October.
If you see anything unsafe before then, stop and tell Marta or me straight away. Shout if I've got anything wrong.
Ben
note: After a safety meeting the recap does not replace the formal incident report: name who logs it, and point people to the health and safety lead for anything new.

situation: I'm Kofi Mensah, a final-year civil engineering student. At our university careers fair today I spoke for five minutes with Laura Chen, a graduate recruiter at Fernhill Rail; she said their graduate scheme closes on Friday 30 October, that they especially value site experience, and asked me to email my CV. I did a 10-week summer placement on a footbridge project and didn't get to mention it.
reply:
Subject: Kofi Mensah, CV following today's careers fair

Hi Laura,
Thank you for taking the time to talk at the careers fair today. You mentioned that Fernhill Rail especially values site experience, so I wanted to add one thing I didn't get to say: this summer I did a 10-week placement on a footbridge project. My CV is attached as you suggested, and I'll submit my application before the graduate scheme closes on Friday 30 October. I'm very interested in the scheme.
Best regards,
Kofi Mensah
note: She met hundreds of students today: a clear subject line and one detail tied to what she said are what make you findable.

situation: I'm Priya Nair. Interviewed yesterday with Helen Brooks, head of finance at Larchmont Foods, for a payroll lead role; she talked a lot about automating their month-end close. I forgot to ask whether the role could start at 9:30 on Tuesdays and Thursdays for my daughter's school drop-off, and I'd rather know now than at offer stage. She said they'd decide by Friday 16 October.
reply:
Hi Helen,
Thank you for the conversation yesterday. Your plans for automating the month-end close stuck with me; it's the kind of work I'd really enjoy. One question I didn't get to ask: could the role start at 9:30 on Tuesdays and Thursdays, for my daughter's school drop-off? I'd rather raise it now than later. I'm very interested in the role and look forward to hearing from you by the 16th.
Best,
Priya Nair
note: The one thing a follow-up adds can be a question; asking before the offer is an honest way to check the fit.

situation: 我叫何雨，今天参加了青禾食品管培生的群面，HR是孙女士。我们组讨论新品怎么在县城推广，我提了先在县城菜市场做试吃，但总结时没讲清楚理由：县城菜市场早上人流最集中。孙女士说10月16日前通知结果。
reply: 孙女士您好，我是今天参加管培生群面的何雨，谢谢您今天的组织和安排。补充一点讨论时没讲清楚的：我提议新品先在县城菜市场做试吃，是因为县城菜市场早上人流最集中，试吃最容易被看到。我很希望加入青禾食品，等您10月16日前的消息。
note: 群面人多，感谢信只补一件事：把讨论里没讲清的那个理由说完整，不重复整场发言。

situation: Soy Lucía Ferrer, presidenta de la comunidad de vecinos de la calle Olmo 14. Hoy nos reunimos con el administrador, el Sr. Navarro, porque el ascensor lleva tres semanas parado: él pedirá dos presupuestos de reparación antes del viernes 9 de octubre, la junta extraordinaria para aprobar uno será el martes 13 de octubre a las 19:00 en el portal, y yo aviso a los vecinos por el grupo de WhatsApp. Quiero mandarle un resumen por correo.
reply:
Buenas tardes, Sr. Navarro:
Gracias por reunirse hoy con nosotros por el ascensor, que ya lleva tres semanas parado. Le resumo lo acordado para que todos tengamos lo mismo:
- Usted: dos presupuestos de reparación antes del viernes 9 de octubre.
- Junta extraordinaria para aprobar uno: martes 13 de octubre a las 19:00 en el portal.
- Yo: aviso a los vecinos por el grupo de WhatsApp.
Si he anotado algo mal, dígamelo y lo corrijo.
Un saludo,
Lucía Ferrer, presidenta de la comunidad de Olmo 14
note: Con un administrador, el resumen escrito convierte lo hablado en plazos que toda la comunidad puede seguir.

situation: I'm Hana Okafor, a hydrologist. Mateo Silva, a reporter at the Ridgeline Courier, interviewed me by phone today about the town's new flood maps and asked me to email him our report. When he asked how many homes are in the new flood zone I guessed 'about 400', but the report says 612, and his story runs on Thursday.
reply:
Hi Mateo,
Thanks for the call today, and for taking the time to get the flood maps right. One correction before Thursday: the number of homes in the new flood zone is 612, not the 'about 400' I guessed on the phone. That figure is from our report, which is attached as you asked. If you'd like to check any other number before the story runs, I'm happy to answer by email.
Best,
Hana Okafor
note: After a press interview, the follow-up that matters is the correction, sent before publication, with the source attached.

situation: I'm Elena Petrov. I auditioned yesterday for second violin in the Riverside Community Orchestra with the conductor, Mr Haas, who said the winter programme is Dvořák's Eighth and rehearsals are Thursdays, 7 to 9:30pm. I told him I could make every Thursday, then remembered I'm away for work on 12 and 19 November; I'd practise the parts at home to keep up. He said he'd let people know by Friday 9 October.
reply:
Hi Mr Haas,
Thank you for hearing me yesterday. Hearing that the winter programme is Dvořák's Eighth made me even keener to join. One correction to what I told you: I'm away for work on Thursday 12 and Thursday 19 November, so I'd miss those two rehearsals, and I'd rather you knew before you decide. I'd practise the parts at home to keep up. I'd love to play with the orchestra and look forward to hearing from you by Friday 9 October.
Best wishes,
Elena Petrov
note: The one thing a follow-up adds can be a correction about yourself; better now than at the first missed rehearsal.

situation: Ich bin Jana Weber. Gestern hatten wir in der Kita Sonnenblume ein Kennenlerngespräch mit der Leiterin, Frau Becker, für unseren Sohn Emil (2); besonders gefallen haben uns die Waldtage jeden Donnerstag, von denen sie erzählt hat. Sie sagte, die Plätze werden bis Ende Oktober vergeben, die Eingewöhnung beginnt frühestens im Januar, und sie braucht noch Emils Impfnachweis, den ich inzwischen eingescannt habe.
reply:
Liebe Frau Becker,
vielen Dank für das Kennenlerngespräch gestern. Die Waldtage jeden Donnerstag gehen uns seitdem nicht aus dem Kopf; genau so etwas wünschen wir uns für Emil. Anbei wie besprochen sein Impfnachweis. Wir wissen, dass die Plätze bis Ende Oktober vergeben werden und die Eingewöhnung frühestens im Januar beginnt, und würden uns sehr über einen Platz freuen. Wenn Sie noch etwas von uns brauchen, melden Sie sich gern.
Viele Grüße
Jana Weber
note: Nach einem Kita-Gespräch wie nach einem Vorstellungsgespräch: ein konkretes Detail, das Fehlende gleich mitschicken, Interesse in einem Satz und vor Ende Oktober nicht nachhaken.

situation: I'm Sam Reid and I make small-batch jam. Yesterday over coffee, Lina Ortiz, who owns Crumb and Co bakery, agreed to a four-week sale-or-return trial: 24 jars at £4 wholesale, delivered by me on Friday 9 October, with a sales review together on Friday 6 November. She asked for allergens on every label, which I've now done. Nothing is in writing yet.
reply:
Hi Lina,
Thanks for the coffee yesterday, and for giving the jam a go. Quick recap so we're working from the same page:
- Four-week sale-or-return trial: 24 jars at £4 wholesale.
- I deliver on Friday 9 October.
- We review sales together on Friday 6 November.
You asked for allergens on every label, and that's done, so the jars will arrive ready for the shelf. Shout if I've got anything wrong.
Sam
note: A deal agreed over coffee becomes real in the recap: the terms, the dates, and the one thing she asked for, already done.
